ideas.pitch: A precision-tuned microcontroller robot optimized for maximum speed on the Robo Race track using aggressive PID control and real-time obstacle detection.
ideas.problem_statement: Robots compete on a designated track featuring turns, obstacles, ramps, and other challenges, needing reliable drive systems and effective control to minimize completion time.
ideas.title: SpeedLine Auto-Steer: High-Speed Line Following & Obstacle Avoidance Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on raw mechanical and software execution to slash completion times, matching the primary judging criteria of speed and zero penalties.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary onboard sensor telemetry and penalty-avoidance system that tracks checkpoint clearances and alerts the driver of impending boundary violations.
ideas.problem_statement: Rankings are determined primarily by completion time, with penalties added for violations such as missing checkpoints, leaving the track, or failing to clear designated obstacles.
ideas.title: Checkpoint Sentinel: Precision Lap & Obstacle Tracking Telemetry Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks the penalty-point deduction system, which is often the tie-breaker and the main reason leading teams lose in time trials.

ideas.pitch: A custom-built mechanical chassis featuring adjustable ground clearance and high-torque motor controllers specifically engineered to conquer steep ramps and rough track obstacles without flipping.
ideas.problem_statement: The robot must meet the prescribed dimensions, weight, and power requirements, with a focus on reliable drive systems, robust construction, and effective control to navigate ramps and obstacles.
ideas.title: RampRider: Dynamic Center-of-Gravity & Traction Management Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the physical destruction and failure points (flipping on ramps) that plague over 50% of competing hardware builds during live trials.

ideas.pitch: A mandatory-compliance hardware safety kill-switch and status indicator module ensuring all electronics, motor drivers, and battery packs are protected against short circuits and runaway states.
ideas.problem_statement: All robots must pass a mandatory safety inspection. Components must be securely mounted, batteries properly protected, and the robot must have a safe and reliable power-control mechanism.
ideas.title: FailSafe-Link: Hardware Emergency Power Cutoff & Telemetry System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Guarantees immediate clearance through the strict mandatory safety inspection phase where many student teams get disqualified before racing.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Raspberry Pi and camera-based vision module mounted on the race rover to detect track boundaries and dynamically correct steering drift at high speeds.
ideas.problem_statement: Robots must complete the course within the stipulated time while staying within the track boundaries, avoiding penalties for leaving the track.
ideas.title: VisionDrift: Edge-AI Assisted Adaptive Path Correction Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an unusual physical build and edge vision processing that stands out from purely analog line-followers in a robotics arena.
